mentions.name: Statically-typed formula engine
mentions.description: A statically-typed formula engine, originally built in-house for the Calcapp app builder, being turned into a real hosted solution as well as a library, complete with documentation and modern tooling.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on turning our statically-typed formula engine -- that we use for Calcapp, our app builder -- into a real hosted solution (as well as a library).
